looks.title: Soft tape
looks.description: Gentle tape wobble follows the bass while a trace of grain rides the beat.

looks.title: Bass buckle
looks.description: Bass hits bend a broad tracking band across the bottom of the picture.

looks.title: Drum tears
looks.description: Detected attacks trigger sharp horizontal tears and quick tape wobble.

looks.title: Color bleed
looks.description: Bass pulls color away from luminance while treble adds colored noise.

looks.title: Color drift
looks.description: Midrange notes rotate the color phase with a smooth falling tail.

looks.title: Snow bursts
looks.description: Percussion throws full-frame white noise that clears between hits.

looks.title: Color dropout
looks.description: A worn long-play tape loses color in rhythmic horizontal bands.

looks.title: Meltdown
looks.description: Tracking, color separation, tape warping, and snow react together.
